name: Teen Advisory Boards (TAB)
what_you_do: Meet with other teens and library staff. Work on library projects with community partners. Help spread the word about library programs. Advise librarians.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students from across Denver. The page lists no age or grade cutoffs. Teens under 18 need a signed parent consent form.
duration: Meetings follow the school calendar. They may be weekly, every other week, or monthly.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline.
how_to_apply: Fill out the TAB interest form. Then follow up with the branch you want to join.
notes: Meetings are in person or online at some branches. The program runs only in English right now. Questions: tab@denverlibrary.org.
